messages:
tina_cs: Hey team — heads up: legal for Acme asked for an SLA evidence bundle ahead of renewal. They want uptime windows, p99 latency by route, incident summaries, and the credits calc spreadsheet. Can eng generate an export for the last 90 days? cc @marcus_sales :eyes:

alex_m: Yep we can. Quick qs — do they need raw logs or the aggregated reports? and is the window 90 days rolling or last quarter?

tina_cs: They said 'last 90 days rolling' in the email. Legal wants both aggregated metrics + incident narratives (customer-facing) for any SLA breaches. Raw logs not necessary unless we need to validate a specific incident.

sam_engineering: I can assemble p99 and uptime-by-route from Observability. I'll pull: dashboards -> /slo/production/route-latency and uptime-export. Will also include the query we used so legal can reproduce. Example query we run for p99:
```
SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 99) AS p99, route, bin(time, 1d) FROM request_metrics WHERE env='prod' AND customer_id='acme' AND time >= now() - 90d GROUP BY route, bin(time, 1d)
```

sam_engineering: Also note that some internal rollout variants were on the 2026-12-05 to 2026-12-12 window and had elevated tail latency — we'll flag those days in the notes.

marcus_sales: Legal specifically asked to see the credits math we apply when uptime < committed. Can someone include the actual calculation example using Acme's committed uptime (99.9%) and their observed uptime? They want the spreadsheet.

alex_m: I'll generate the spreadsheet. Formula we use in the playbook is: credit = tier_rate * contract_monthly_fee where tier_rate depends on uptime bucket. I can attach the CSV with both daily uptime and aggregated month buckets. Sample pseudo-formula we typically send in docs:
```
if uptime >= 99.9% -> credit = 0
if 99.0% <= uptime < 99.9% -> credit = 10% * monthly_fee
if 95.0% <= uptime < 99.0% -> credit = 25% * monthly_fee
if uptime < 95% -> credit = 50% * monthly_fee
```

tina_cs: Perfect. Legal asked for an incident narrative template so it's consistent. Please include: incident id, start/end, impact (customers affected), root cause, mitigation, and follow-up actions. We should redact any internal IDs that aren’t customer-facing.

sam_engineering: I'll add a short narrative for the two incidents in the 90d window that triggered SLO breaches. Drafts will be customer-ready.

marcus_sales: Action items: 1) alex_m — build CSV & credit calc examples (due EOD tomorrow) 2) sam_engineering — p99 + uptime exports + incident narratives (due EOD +48h) 3) tina_cs — consolidate and run by legal (once above items are in). If anyone can't meet, flag now. :thumbsup:

alex_m: Copy that — I'll also include a notes sheet showing rounding rules and any manual adjustments we've accepted historically.

sam_engineering: FYI deploy-bot says archived traces for the dates in question are available at https://console.redwood.ai/observability/traces?start=2026-12-01&end=2027-02-28 — I'll link individual trace IDs in the narrative.

tina_cs: Great — legal-bot asked that all docs be uploaded to the shared S3 folder: s3://redwood-cs/acme/sla-evidence/ once ready. We'll keep a changelog in the folder.

legal-bot: Reminder: please ensure all PII is redacted and that the incident narratives avoid internal postmortem language. Customer-facing tone required.

alex_m: Noted. I'll scrub any internal hostnames and user IDs before upload.

tina_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with legal after uploads. If anything changes on scope, I'll ping here. :raised_hands:
